verdict.rationale: Obsidian Sync is an official add-on that privately syncs notes across devices (obsidian-docs-32), with selective sync and version history (obsidian-docs-47, obsidian-docs-28). Its end-to-end encryption is on by default, and the docs state that not even the Obsidian team can access your notes (obsidian-docs-21, obsidian-docs-48, obsidian-docs-35, obsidian-docs-9). One community user confirms relying on the sync service (obsidian-comm-9). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the E2E encryption claim and of cross-device sync reliability.
